text_post: Good evening Fellows and Gents. In recent days, we received a handful of reports from a few about private messaging. Maybe you couldn’t start a PM with someone, couldn’t see the “MESSAGE” button on their profile, or vice versa. We have gone in, tested and are pretty sure it’s all sorted, need another day to be sure, but here is the way it works. 1. BASIC MEMBERS cannot start a PM with anybody. This is just common sense so a newbie can’t just start chatting with you. But they can reply up to 3 times a day…. so basic members have a limited ability to private message, swap emails, or keep it short. 2. Upgraded GHOST and GALT members can message anyone who allows it. So if you can’t see a “MESSAGE” button on their profile, they don’t want you to. These member levels also have extended privacy settings so they can make their profile private, they can also set rules like “Only people I follow can message me” and “only people I follow can view my profile” etc. That’s what the “follow” button is for. It’s not to be stalker or anything like that….. it’s to say “This dude is cool. He can follow, read or PM me” . Visit/adjust your profile/privacy settings on your “account” page: /account/privacy/ We would recommend you keep yourself visible, viewable and reachable unless you would really rather not. Only logged in members can see “who’s online now”. EXAMPLE: I accidentally had my privacy setting set to “only people I follow can view my profile” and “ nobody can message me”. That was my mistake and that’s why you thought it was malfunctioning. I have changed this to “only people I follow can PM me”. So if I am following you and you can’t see a message button… please tell me. If you should notice permissions are not working as explained above, leave a message below and we can override login as you and check it out. PS. We are doing some work on our mgtow.com emails, so if you tried to email me ( personally) and it couldn’t be delivered, we know. Otherwise the contact form is working as expected and all of that. This thread will be super-sticky for 24-48 hours and then will be moved to Q&A only. Thanks very much.
